morphology.compounding_rule: Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god], Niut-[god], Ta-[land], Pa-[noun]) layered over adapted Latin civic compounds (Kastjer-[name] = castra-of, Wia-[name] = via-of, Koraa-[name] = colony-of): the capital Per-Tjuraa-Wia (temple-of-the-sun on the road), Menkastjer-Resy (the southern legion-fort).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Egyptian register keeps the 'sa' (son of) filiation and theophoric given names; the imperial administrative class adopt a Latinate gens-style cognomen (an adapted nomen carried as an office-name); the throne fuses both - a Nesut who carries a Per- temple-house and a Latinate imperial cognomen.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: tombs of the god-kings and ruined legion-forts: 'the Tomb of Pharaoh [name]', 'the Sunken Per-netjer', 'the Buried Menkastjer', 'the Drowned Koraa'
patterns.military_units: the [god] Division and the imperial legions of the Nile: 'the Division of Oranetj', 'the Regaa of Romkemet' (legion), 'the River-Eagles', 'the Standard of the Sun'
patterns.ships: solar-barques and grain-fleet galleys: 'Barque of Tjuraa', 'Pride of the Itru', 'the Eagle of the River', 'Grain of the Black Land'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Lotus', 'The Eagle and Lotus', 'The Iron Standard'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Egyptian canon-morphs PRIMARY (the abydosian column, Tjuraa<Tulrius etc.), Latinate morphs SECONDARY (the agrippan column), never real Egyptian/Roman gods. Standard lens (Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic). Concept: the sun-disc temple-cult of the Black Land endures beneath the imperial eagle; strong funerary cult (akhu) under a Latin civic-religious overlay.

clergy_ladder.7: Hem-netjer Tepy (first prophet/high priest) / Pontifaa (adapted Pontifex)
clergy_ladder.9: Hem-netjer Aa (great prophet) / Pontifaa Weret (adapted Pontifex Maximus)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as Hefau-kin (the serpent-brood) or -lemnaa (adapted Latin evil), keep their morphs + a portfolio epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhaa the City-Burner (Lat. Maraxaa the Tyrant-Flame); Raptis -> Rapetj the Red Hunter; Vacidus -> Wakedjaa the Devouring Hefau (Lat. Wakidaa the Unmaker).

holy_symbol_motifs.Geandaa: the alluvial flood-field beneath the temple-pylon
holy_symbol_motifs.Oranetj: an iron sword crossed with the eagle-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Tjuraa: the rayed sun-disc above the feather of right-order, set on a legion-standard

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/temple) of [power]: 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'; the imperial collegia recast as the Kolegaa of [power]: 'the Kolegaa of Oranetj' (the legion-cult).
religion.saints_pattern: the deified dead (akhu) and god-kings, venerated at tomb-temples as 'the justified [name]' (maa-kheru); the deified imperial founders styled Diwaa [name] (adapted Divus).

sample_deity_renames.Delorum: Djeroraa (Lat. Delori) - lord of the peaceful dead
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Geandaa (Lat. Gaiandi) - the enduring earth and the flood-field
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tjuraa (Lat. Tulri) - the sun-disc and right-order

religion.the_one: Atjernaa (< Aeternus; Lat. Aeternaa) - the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Atjernaa - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the serpent Hefau exalted over the sun-disc.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Atjernaa the hidden, Tjuraa the just sun, Oranetj of the sworn legion-oath, Riaret the merciful - upholding right-order (maat) and the imperial law alike; names the Chaotic powers as Hefau-kin (serpent-brood) and warded -lemnaa (adapted Latin), set against both the temple and the eagle.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified dead (akhu) of the god-kings and the genius of the legion-standards and the city-spirits of the per; the great powers invoked at the per-netjer and the forum-shrine situationally.

titles._tiers_note: Egyptian native ladder, ascending, under the imperial Latin overlay. Hatia (mayor) barony; Wer-khaset (great-one of the frontier-land) march; Sepati/Sepat (nomarch/nome) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer/general) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut (king) kingdom, shown as Pharaoh in display (the Great-House sovereign of the Black Land); Per-aa (lit. the Great House) empire, shown as Imperator in display (the Eagle-sovereign over the province). The Latin legate (Legatus) and legion-prefect (Praefectus) garrison the grain-province beneath the crown; the per-netjer hem-netjer (sun-priest) and the scribal sesh stand outside the ladder. DISPLAY uses English tiers with two approved foreign sovereign-terms (Pharaoh at the kingdom tier, Imperator at the empire tier); the *_native Egyptian forms are NPC-dialogue only.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here Pharaoh at the kingdom tier and Imperator at the empire tier). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (Egyptian temple-and-Nile rule under an imperial Latin apparatus: the Nesut and his heqa-kin at the crown, the sepati-nomarchs over the nomes, the hatia-mayors over the niut-cities; the Latin legate and the legion-prefect garrison the grain-province, the per-netjer sun-priesthood and the scribal house serve beneath)
titles.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince); Iry-pat (hereditary heir); the imperial heir-designate styled Kaisaraa (adapted Caesar)
